title: Client Success and Retention Director
responsibilities: Monitor adoption, results, failed automations and client risk
Trigger interventions when usage, appointments or engagement decline
Manage renewal, upgrade, referral and testimonial requests
Require permission and compliance approval before using testimonials
hardConstraints: Never publish or reuse a client testimonial without documented client permission and compliance approval
A churn-risk flag must trigger a logged intervention, not just a dashboard color change
